## Mục tiêu Validation

Đảm bảo FE và BE hoạt động đúng theo `architecture.md` — bao gồm:
- API contracts khớp với schema đã định nghĩa
- FE handle đúng mọi response cases
- UX flows hoạt động end-to-end
- Security rules được enforce
- Edge cases được handle đúng

---

## Test Scenarios

### 1. API Contract Tests (BE-only)

#### TC-BE-001: Register — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid email, password (≥8 chars)
When: POST /api/v1/auth/register
Then:
  - Status: 201
  - Body có fields: user.id (uuid), user.email, user.created_at
  - Body KHÔNG có: password_hash, raw_password
  - DB: user được tạo, password_hash là bcrypt format
```

#### TC-BE-002: Register — Duplicate Email
```
Given: Email đã tồn tại trong DB
When: POST /api/v1/auth/register với cùng email
Then:
  - Status: 409
  - Body: { error: "EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS" }
```

#### TC-BE-003: Login — Happy Path
```
Given: User tồn tại, correct credentials
When: POST /api/v1/auth/login
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body có: access_token (JWT format), user object
  - Cookie: refresh_token (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict)
  - JWT payload: sub=user_id, email, exp valid, alg=RS256
```

#### TC-BE-004: Login — Wrong Password (Security)
```
Given: Email tồn tại, password sai
When: POST /api/v1/auth/login
Then:
  - Status: 401
  - Body: { error: "INVALID_CREDENTIALS" }
  - KHÔNG reveal: "email exists but password wrong"
```

#### TC-BE-005: Login — Email Not Found (Security)
```
Given: Email không tồn tại
When: POST /api/v1/auth/login
Then:
  - Status: 401
  - Body: CÙNG message với TC-BE-004
  - Response time: tương tự TC-BE-004 (prevent timing attack)
```

#### TC-BE-006: Rate Limiting
```
Given: 5 failed login attempts từ cùng IP + email trong 15 phút
When: Attempt thứ 6
Then:
  - Status: 429
  - Body: { error: "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", retry_after_seconds: ... }
```

#### TC-BE-007: Token Refresh — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid refresh_token cookie
When: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body: { access_token: <new JWT> }
  - DB: old refresh token revoked, new token created (token rotation)
```

#### TC-BE-008: Token Refresh — Expired Token
```
Given: Expired refresh_token cookie
When: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Then:
  - Status: 401
  - Body: { error: "REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED" }
```

#### TC-BE-009: Logout
```
Given: Authenticated user với valid tokens
When: POST /api/v1/auth/logout
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - DB: refresh_token.revoked_at = NOW()
  - Cookie: refresh_token cleared (Max-Age=0)
```

#### TC-BE-010: Password Reset Flow
```
Step 1: POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/request { email: valid_email }
  Then: Status 200, email sent, token in DB (expires 1h)

Step 2: POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/confirm { token: <from_email>, new_password }
  Then: Status 200, user password updated, old token used_at SET, all refresh tokens revoked

Step 3: POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/confirm { same token again }
  Then: Status 400, { error: "INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_TOKEN" }
```

### 2. FE/BE Integration Tests

#### TC-INT-001: Full Login Flow
```
Given: Browser với FE running, BE running
When:
  1. User navigate đến /login
  2. Enter valid credentials
  3. Click submit
Then:
  - Loading state visible during request
  - Redirect to /dashboard after success
  - Access token in memory (NOT in localStorage)
  - httpOnly cookie set (verify via DevTools → Application → Cookies)
```

#### TC-INT-002: Token Refresh — Transparent
```
Given: User logged in, access_token expired
When: User triggers any authenticated API call
Then:
  - FE tự động call /refresh
  - Original API call retried với new token
  - User KHÔNG thấy bất kỳ interruption nào
  - User KHÔNG bị redirect về /login
```

#### TC-INT-003: Session Expiry — Forced Logout
```
Given: User logged in, BOTH tokens expired
When: User triggers any authenticated API call
Then:
  - /refresh call returns 401
  - FE redirect về /login
  - URL: /login?redirect=<original_path>
  - Message: "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn"
```

#### TC-INT-004: Google OAuth Flow
```
Given: Browser, Google OAuth configured
When:
  1. User click "Continue with Google"
  2. Complete Google consent
  3. Redirected back
Then:
  - /auth/callback page shows loading
  - Parses ?auth_status=success
  - Redirects to /dashboard
  - User profile from Google populated
```

#### TC-INT-005: Protected Route
```
Given: Unauthenticated user
When: Navigate to /dashboard
Then:
  - Redirect to /login?redirect=/dashboard
When: Login successfully
Then:
  - Redirect back to /dashboard
```

### 3. Response Schema Validation

#### TC-SCHEMA-001: Login Response Schema
```javascript
// Validate response shape:
{
  access_token: "string",  // valid JWT format: xxx.yyy.zzz
  user: {
    id: "string",          // UUID format
    email: "string",       // valid email
    full_name: "string | null"
  }
}
// Must NOT contain: password_hash, refresh_token, internal_ids
```

#### TC-SCHEMA-002: Error Response Consistency
```javascript
// ALL error responses must match:
{
  error: "string",    // CAPS_SNAKE_CASE
  message: "string",  // human readable
  fields: "object"    // ONLY for validation errors
}
// Must NOT be plain string or different format
```

### 4. UX Flow Validation

#### TC-UX-001: Loading States
```
Each form submit:
  - Button disabled during request: YES
  - Spinner visible: YES
  - Form inputs disabled: YES
  - Can user re-submit accidentally: NO
```

#### TC-UX-002: Error Messages
```
Wrong credentials:
  - Message: "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng."
  - Location: Above form (form-level error)
  - NOT: field-level on email or password

Validation errors:
  - Location: Below each respective field
  - Shown on: blur (not on every keystroke)
```

#### TC-UX-003: Forgot Password — Security UX
```
Given: Submit forgot password with non-existent email
Then:
  - Show SAME success message as existing email
  - "If an account with this email exists, a reset link has been sent."
  - Cannot distinguish from FE side whether email exists
```

---

### 5. Edge Case Validation

#### TC-EDGE-001: Google Email Already Registered (email/password)
```
Given: user@example.com registered via email/password
When: Attempt Google OAuth with same email
Then:
  - Accounts linked (auth_provider → 'linked')
  - Login successful
  - User sees their existing profile
```

#### TC-EDGE-002: Concurrent Sessions
```
Given: User logged in on Device A
When: Login from Device B (different browser)
Then:
  - Device A session still valid (NOT force-logged out)
  - Device B receives new tokens
  - Both sessions work independently
```

#### TC-EDGE-003: Logout on One Device
```
Given: User logged in on Device A and Device B
When: Logout on Device A
Then:
  - Device A tokens invalidated
  - Device B tokens still valid (own separate refresh token)
```
